# SI027 — policy-hash-not-rechecked

Adjudication must re-check the live policy against the pinned hash.

## Why

A policy URL can change after filing. Without a hash comparison the verdict may judge different text.

## Bad

```python
policy_text = fetch(policy.url)
# no hash check
```

## Good

```python
if sha256(policy_text) != policy.text_hash:
    raise Exception('POLICY_DRIFT')
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI027 -- reason
```
